summary: Iter538 verification: backend ride-cancel WS notify + accept-409 wording AND new admin broadcast notif manager (CRUD+send). 7 backend pytest cases pass; full E2E admin UI flow (login → /admin/notif-settings → create → edit → delete on merchant audience) succeeds with French toasts and proper cleanup.
critical_code_review_comments: send_broadcast() in push_web.py swallows all exceptions per user (except: pass). OK for fire-and-forget but consider counting failures separately for observability.
send_broadcast() to 'all' audience iterates the entire users collection sequentially — fine for now (~hundreds of users) but should be batched with asyncio.gather chunks if user count grows.
admin_router /broadcasts has no rate-limit; an accidental double-click on Send could double-notify users — frontend uses window.confirm which mitigates but not bulletproof.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_iter538_broadcast_admin.py (new HTTP regression for admin broadcast CRUD + send)
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_iter538/TEST_UI broadcast docs in notif_broadcasts AND triggered one /send to 'merchant' (≤~12 users). All broadcast docs deleted at end of tests; the announcement notifications created by /send were purged via db.notifications.delete_many({type:'announcement', data.broadcast_id: bid}).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend HTTP regression for the admin broadcast manager lives at tests/test_iter538_broadcast_admin.py (uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env). Cancel-notify regression at tests/test_iter538_cancel_notify.py uses monkeypatched manager.send_personal_message. Frontend admin UI uses data-testid='broadcast-manager' with broadcast-{title,audience,body,url}-input/-select, broadcast-submit-btn, and per-row broadcast-row-{id}/edit/delete/send. Send button uses window.confirm — accept via page.once('dialog', lambda d: d.accept()).
rca of the issue: N/A — feature works as specified. cancel_ride emits a dedicated ride_cancelled WS message to ride.driver_user_id (room-independent) AND creates an in-app notification with body containing 'annulée par le client' (verified via test_cancel_notifies_assigned_driver). accept_ride returns tailored 404/409 when the ride is cancelled vs claimed (verified).
